tuv.seg: yon na morcu, imi rixencu cel in finikal jiwa.
it is in dying that one is raised to eternal life.
Siri-Logane Tutum
The Secret-Telling Heart
To sen sati!
It's true!
Mi le sen daymo, daymo ansyapul, ji mi haji sen denpul, mas yu fikir ki mi sen majnuni keseba?
I was very, very scared, and I still am, but why do you think that I'm crazy?
Misu bimarya le balagi misu gancikowa.
My disease strengthened my senses.
To le no destrui or daifugi oto.
It didn't destroy or weaken them.
Misu maxim bala gancikowa le sen misu oreya.
My strongest sense was my hearing.
Mi le abil na ore moyto in Janatu ji in Dunya.
I could hear everything in Heaven and on Earth.
Mi le ore multi xey in Jahanom.
I heard many things in Hell.
Finto, mi sen majnuni kemaner?
So, how am I crazy?
Am juiore, ji am jui ku mi abil na kemo trankwilo ji mingu loga tas yu total hikaye.
Listen up, and pay attention to how calmly and clearly I can tell you the whole story.
Mi no jixi ku idey le ofata keloka, mas denwatu hu to le precu, to le kostante lawfen mi.
I don't know where the idea came from, but when it appeared, it constantly bothered me.
Le no hay seba kos to.
There was no reason for it.
Le no hay bala ganjon tem to.
There was no strong feeling about it.
Fe fato, mi le suki lao manixu.
I actually liked the old man.
Te le nilwatu guton mi.
He never hurt me.
Te le nilwatu burganjongi mi.
He never made me upset.
Mi le no vole tesu pesa.
I didn't want his money.
Mi fikir ki seba le sen tesu oko!
I think that it was because of his eye!
Si, dento le sen seba!
Yes, it was that!
Un to of tesu oko okocu sim kom to de nasru, sefidemo blue oko har dambo cengu per to.
One of his eyes looked like a vulture's, a light blue eye with a thin layer over it.
Denwatu hu to le oko mi, mi le ganjoncu fobido, ji mi le karar xosu xafe xosu na morgi lao manixu cel na awgi tesu oko cel moywatu.
Whenever it looked at me, I felt scared, and I very slowly decided to kill the old man to get rid of his eye forever.
Prehay cuyotyan.
Here's the point.
Yu fikir ki mi sen majnuni.
You think that I'm crazy.
Majnuniyen jixi nilto.
Crazy people know nothing.
Mas yu le ingay na oko mi.
But you should've seen me.
Yu le ingay na oko ku mi le aksyon kemo gomyo; daymo juipul, daymo cinonpul, daymo sirili, mi le ergo!
You should've seen how cleverly I acted; very carefully, very smartly, very secretly, I worked!
Mi le nilwatu sen maxmo lutufpul tas lao manixu kom dur total safta leki mi le morgi te.
I was never nicer to the old man than during the whole week before I killed him.
Ji fe moy noce daju fe midinoce, mi le rota hantatul de tesu dwer, ji mi le buka to: o, daydenmo narem!
And every night at about midnight, I turned the latch of his door and opened it: oh, so gently!
Ji jaxali, denwatu hu mi le fale kufimo day bukaxey tas misu kapi, mi le ingi luminkal lenterna, kompletomo klosido celki nil lumin brila, ji jaxali, mi le pasgi misu kapi.
And then, when I made a hole big enough for my head, I put in a dark lantern, completely closed so no light shined out, and then I put my head through.
O, yu le ingay na oko ku mi le pasgi to kemo gomyo!
Oh, you should've seen how cunningly I put it through!
Mi le harka to hanman, daymo, daymo hanman, celki mi no jundwan somno de manixu.
I moved it slowly, very, very slowly, so I wouldn't disrupt the old man's sleep.
Mi le pasa un satu cel na kufi pasgi misu kapi celki mi abil na oko te durki te le leta per sesu bistar.
It took me an hour to put my head through enough so that I could see him as he laid on his bed.
Ha!
Hah!
Kam majnuniyen ger le sen denmo gomyo kom hinto?
Would a crazy person have been as clever as this?
Ji jaxali, denwatu hu misu kapi le kompleto sen in kamer, mi le buka lenterna juipul, daymo juipul (koski bisagra le soti); mi le kufi buka to celki dambo radya fe lumin celidi oko de nasru.
And then when my head was fully in the room, I opened the lantern carefully, very carefully (because the hinges made noise); I opened it just enough for a thin ray of light to reach the vulture eye.
Ji mi le fale hinto dur sabe noce, moy noce preciso fe midinoce, mas mi le oko ki oko moywatu sen klosido; fe folo, na fale ergo le sen nenible.
And I did this for seven long nights, every night at exactly midnight, but I saw that the eye was always closed, so it was impossible to do the work.
To le no sen lao manixu hu da le lawfen mi; to le sen tesu Bur Oko.
It wasn't the old man that bothered me; it was his Evil Eye.
Ji fe moy soba, denwatu hu dinlumin le ata, mi le sexinloypul inidi kamer, ji mi le yunkipul pala tas te, le kweho voka tesu name ji le swal ku tesu noce sen kepul.
And every morning, when the daylight came, I confidently entered the room and spoke boldly to him, cheerfully calling him by name, and asked how his night was.
Te ger le musi na sen daymo cinonpul cel na gixim ki fe moy noce preciso fe midinoce, mi juioko te durki te somno.
He'd have to be really smart to find out that every night at exactly midnight, I looked at him while he slept.
Fe ocoyum noce, mi le sen maxmo juipul kom xugwanpul denwatu hu mi le buka dwer.
On the eighth night, I was more cautious than usual when I opened the door.
Mi le harka misu hanta maxmo hanman kom minuto-ixara de satumeter.
I moved my hand more slowly than a watch's minute hand.
Mi le nilwatu xoraham daraje de misu abilya ji sofi denpul kom fe den noce.
I never realized the extent of my abilities and wisdom like I did that night.
Mi le eskaso abil na krasi misu ganjon fe triunfa.
I could hardly contain my feeling of triumph.
Am imaje mi fe na buka dwer xosu xafe xosu, ji te fe na sen ixikal fe misu sirili aksyon ji fikir.
Imagine me opening the door little by little, and him being unaware of my secret actions and thoughts.
Mi le bankwanti lilhaha kos den idey, ji te le ible ore mi koski te le abruto harka per sesu bistar kwasimo surprisado.
I somewhat chuckled at the idea, and he might have heard me because he suddenly moved on the bed as if startled.
Yu ible fikir ki mi le rukadam, mas no.
You might think that I retreated, but no.
Tesu kamer le sen kompletomo luminkal (janela le sen tangemo klosido kos fobi fe ofcoriyen), ji kos to, mi le jixi ki te no abil na oko dwer fe na buka, ji mi le duregi na pel to hanman, hanman.
His room was completely dark (the windows were tightly closed because of a fear of robbers), and so I knew that he couldn't see the door opening, and I kept pushing it steadily, steadily.
Misu kapi le sen fe inya, ji mi le jaxa buka lenterna, denwatu hu misu dayxuji deleza per estanoli liftitul, ji lao manixu le sidecu per bistar, fe na dayloga, "Kete sen denloka!?"
My head was inside, and I was about to open the lantern when my thumb slipped on the tin lever, and the old man sat up in the bed, shouting, "Who's there!?"
Mi le resta totalmo harkakal ji le loga nilto.
I kept quite still and said nothing.
Fe total satu, mi le no harka adola, ji fe durya, mi le no ore te na letacu.
For a whole hour I did not move a muscle, and in the meantime, I did not hear him lie down.
Te le haji side per bistar, fe na ore, preciso denmaner hu mi le fale to fe moy noce, dur na ore gubangu in divar.
He still sat in the bed, listening, just as I did night after night, listening to the beetles in the wall.
Nerxali, mi le ore daifu exnafasu, ji mi le jixi ki to sen exnafasu fe teror.
Soon, I heard a weak exhale, and I knew that it was the exhale of terror.
To le no sen exnafasu fe guton or hazuniya, o no!
It wasn't an exhale of pain or sadness, oh no!
To le sen sotilil, inhifazido soti hu da exata of amikuya de ruho denwatu hu to sen pul fe fobi.
It was the quiet, held-in sound that comes from the bottom of the soul when filled with fear.
Mi le kone hin soti bon.
I knew that sound well.
Fe multi noce, preciso fe midinoce, denwatu hu moyte le somno, to le xunjan in misu cati, fe na maxgi fobi hu da le lawfen mi yon sesu rusoti.
Many nights, at exactly midnight, when everyone was asleep, it grew in my chest, increasing the fears that bothered me with its frightening echo.
Mi loga tas yu, mi le kone to bon.
I tell you, I knew it well.
Mi le jixi ku lao manixu ganjon keto, ji mi le ganjon simpati tas te, fe hataya ki mi le sirili fikir ki to sen humorpul.
I knew what the old man felt, and pitied him, although I secretly thought that it was funny.
Mi le jixi ki te sen jage xorfe unyum lil soti hu denwatu te le jwan in bistar.
I knew that he had been awake since the first slight noise when he turned in bed.
Tesu plu fobi le xunjan xorfe denwatu.
His fears had been growing since then.
Te le xidu na imanugi se ki oto sen basikal, mas te le no sukses.
He had tried to convince himself that they were baseless, but he couldn't.

Te le loga tas se, "To sen sol vento in dudantubo, to sen sol maux hu da trasidi dixan," or "To sen sol krigiri hu da le fale un solo krigirisa." Si, te le xidu na anwi se yon hin plu jadin, mas te le no xorhare sukses.

He had been telling himself, "It's just the wind in the chimney, it's just a mouse crossing the floor," or "It's just a cricket that made a single chirp." Yes, he has been trying to comfort himself with these suppositions, but he had no success.
To le no funsyon koski Morya, durki te le nercu cel te, le fale sesu luminkal saye fe fronta de te, ji Morya le lifafa te in to.
It didn't work because Death, as he approached him, made his dark shadow in front of him and wrapped him in it.
Ji den nenokodo saye le kosa ki te ganci misu presen in kamer, fe hataya ki te le noro oko nor ore mi.
And that unseen shadow made him sense, although he neither saw nor heard, my presence in the room.
Xafe na intizar daymo sabar dur lungo watu wal na ore te na letacu, mi le karar na buka daylil daraki in lenterna.
After waiting very patiently for a long time without hearing him lie down, I decided to open a very small crevice in the lantern.
Mi le buka to daymo, daymo juipul finki un solo luminlil radya, denpul kom xilo de kumi, le exidi daraki ji le celidi nasruli oko.
So I opened it very, very carefully until a single dim ray, like the thread of a spider, came out of the crevice and reached the vulture eye.
To le sen pahnamo bukado, ji mi le sencu gadibu denwatu hu mi le juioko to.
It was widely open, and I got angry when I looked at it.
Mi le oko to perfeto.
I saw it perfectly.

To le sen daifumo blue har ajabu koberi per to hu da le day fobi mi, mas mi le no abil na oko resta de muka or jismu de lao manixu koski mi le lide radya preciso cel sahi lokabage wal na musi na fikir.

It was a dull blue with a strange covering over it that really frightened me, but I couldn't see the rest of the old man's face or body because I directed the ray at exactly the right spot without having to think.
Ji kam yu memori to hu denwatu mi le loga ki dento hu yu fikir ki da sen majnuniya sen sol maxboncu fe gancikowa?
And remember when I said that what you think is craziness is just increased senses?
Nunto, mi le ore lil, velosi soti, denpul kom satumeter lifafado in koton.
Well, I heard a brief little sound, like a watch wrapped in cotton.
Mi le kone pia den soti.
I knew that sound well, too.
To le sen nabiza de tutum de lao manixu.
It was the beating of the old man's heart.
To le sengi mi maxmo gadibu, denmaner hu darbe fe drumu yunki askeriyen.
It made me angrier, like how the beating of a drum encourages a soldier.
Mas fe hataya fe dento, mi le estowoju mi ji le resta harkakal.
But despite that, I resisted and stayed still.
Mi le eskaso nafasu.
I barely breathed.
Mi le restagi lenterna harkakal.
I kept the lantern still.
Mi le jaribi ku mi abil na restagi radya kemo harkakal per oko.
I tested how still I could keep the ray on the eye.
Fe durya, nabiza de tutum le maxbalacu.
Meanwhile, the beating of the heart increased.
To le sencu maxmo ji maxmo velosi, maxmo ji maxmo sotipul, sekundo xafe sekundo.
It became faster and faster, louder and louder, every moment.
Manixu le dayible sen kompletomo dayfobido!
The man must have been absolutely terrified!
To le sencu maxmo sotipul, mi riloga, maxmo sotipul, fol moyun sekundo!
It grew louder, I repeat, louder, every second!
Kam yu aham mi?
Do you understand me?
Mi le uje zekaru ki mi asan sencu fobido, to sen sati.
I already mentioned that I easily get scared, and I am.
Ji fe midiya de noce, in fobine sotikalya de den lama baytu, daydenmo ajabu soti le kompleto fobi mi.
And in the middle of the night, in the dreadful silence of that old house, such a strange noise completely terrified me.
Hatali, mi le resta harkakal dur bannumer maxpul minuto.
Even so, I kept still for a few more minutes.
Mas nabiza le sencu maxmo ji maxmo sotipul!
But the beating got louder and louder!
Mi le fikir ki tutum xa pom.
I thought the heart would burst.
Ji jaxali, neo banto le yolyu mi: soti ible beore jara!
And then something new worried me: the sound might be heard by a neighbor!
Watu fe morcu de lao manixu le preata!
The time of the old man's death had come!
Ton sotipul cihe, mi le buka lenterna ji le tyao cel in kamer.
With a loud yell, I opened the lantern and jumped into the room.
Te le ayay un mara, ji sol un mara.
He screamed once, and only once.
Jaxali momento, mi le pospel te cel dixan ji le plasi wazenpul bistar per te.
The next moment, I pulled him to the floor and put the heavy bed on top of him.
Jaxali, mi le tabasum kweho, fe na jixi ki fale kriban sen finido.
Then I smiled cheerfully, knowing that the deed was almost finished.
Mas dur multi minuto, tutum le duregi na nabiza har koberido soti.
But for many minutes, the heart kept beating with a muffled sound.
Hatali, hinto le no lawfen mi koski to ger no beore pas divar.
This, however, didn't bother me, as it wouldn't be heard through the wall.
Fe fini, to le esto.
Finally, it stopped.
Lao manixu le sen mor.
The old man was dead.
Mi le harka bistar ji le moni morjismu.
I moved the bed and examined the corpse.
Si, te le sen kompletomo, kompletomo mor.
Yes, he was completely, completely dead.
Mi le plasi misu hanta per tesu tutum ji le restagi to denloka dur multi minuto.
I put my hand on his heart and kept it there for many minutes.
Le no hay nabiza.
There was no pulse.
Te le sen kompletomo mor.
He was completely dead.
Tesu oko le no haji lawfen mi.
His eye would not bother me anymore.
Eger yu haji fikir ki mi sen majnuni, yu xa no haji fikir dento denwatu hu mi xa tosifu gomyo xey hu mi le fale da cel na sangu jismu.
If you still think I'm crazy, you won't think that anymore when I describe the clever things I did to hide the body.
Durki noce le pasa, mi le ergo velosi mas sotikal.
As the night passed, I worked quickly but quietly.
Mi le ofplasi tiga tahta of dixan de kamer ji le plasi moyto in neo bukaxey.
I removed three planks from the floor of the room and put everything in the opening.
Jaxali, mi le ruplasi tahta daydenmo gomyo, ki fe folo nil insanli oko, no hata tesu to, ger abil na xorjui mal banto.
Then, I put the boards back so cunningly that no human eye, not even his, could have noticed anything wrong.
Le hay nilto na safegi.
There was nothing to clean.
Nil burtyan, nil damuplax.
No stains, no blood splatters.
Mi le sen godomo juipul tem dento.
I was too cautious for that.
Xaki mi le fini misu ergo, to le sen satu care, haji denmo luminkal kom midinoce.
After I finished my work, it was four o'clock, still as dark as midnight.
Denwatu hu satu le rinjon, le hay toka per dwer fe fronta.
When the bell rang at the hour, there was a knock at the front door.
Mi le joxupul idi cel na buka to, koski mi le hare keto na befobi fe nunya?
I cheerfully went to open it, because what did I have now to fear?
Tiga manixu le inidi, hu da adebupul xorkonegi se denpul kom polisiyen.
Three men entered, who politely introduced themselves as police officers.
Ayay le beore jara dur noce hu da maxgi fikir ki bur banto le befale; informe le begibe tas polisidom, ji polisiyen le beirsal cel na ofxerca zona.

A scream had been heard by a neighbor during the night, increasing suspicions that something bad was done; information was given to the police station, and they (the officers) were sent to search the area.
Mi le tabasum, koski mi le hare keto na befobi?
I smiled, because what did I have to fear?
Mi le bonatagi manixu.
I welcomed the men.
Mi le loga tas ete ki cihe le sen kos misu roya, ji ki lao manixu sen awsenli in nongyogeo.
I told them that the scream was from my dream, and that the old man was away in the countryside.
Mi le gida misu visitayen wey baytu.
I guided my visitors around the house.
Mi le loga tas ete ki ete am xerca, ji am xerca bon.
I told them to search, and to search well.
Fe fini, mi le gida ete cel tesu kamer.
Finally, I guided them to his room.
Mi le onexa tas ete tesu jacipulxey, anjen ji nenharkado.
I showed them his valuables, safe and unmoved.
Daymo sexinloypul, mi le preporta kursi cel in kamer ji le teyan ki ete am sidecu ji laxocu, durki mi, fe na ganjoncu triunfapul, le plasi misu kursi supra to hu denloka morjismu de korbani le leta.
Very confidently, I brought chairs into the room and offered them to sit down and relax, while I, feeling victorious, placed my chair above where the victim's corpse lay.
Polisiyen le sen truti.
The officers were satisfied.
Misu konduta le imanugi ete.
My behavior convinced them.
Mi le sen juilayemo estreskal.
I was remarkably unstressed.
Ete le sidecu, ji durki mi le jawabu kweho, imi le intrepala ordinari.
They sat down, and while I responded cheerfully, we conversed casually.
Mas nerxali, mi le xoru na sencu cambay ji le vole ki ete am awidi.
But soon, I started to become pale and wanted them to leave.
Misu kapi le guton, ji mi le fikir ki mi ore rinjon in misu ore; mas ete le duregi na pala.
My head hurt, and I thought that I heard a ringing in my ears; but they kept talking.
Rinjon le sencu maxmo ji maxmo xorjuiible.
The ringing became more and more noticeable.
Mi le pala maxmo huru cel na esto ganjon, mas to le dure ji sencu hata maxmo xorjuiible, finki finili, mi le xoraham ki soti no ofata misu ore.
I talked more freely to stop the feeling, but it continued and became even more noticeable, until finally, I realized that the noise did not come from my ears.
Mi le xankakal sencu cambay, mas mi le pala maxmo velosi ji sotipul.
I definitely became very pale, but I talked more quickly and loudly.
Soti le sencu maxmo sotipul, ji mi le no jixi ku na fale keto.
The sound became louder, and I didn't know what to do.
To le sen sotikal, nenmingu, velosi soti, denpul kom satumeter koberido in koton.
It was a quiet, covered, fast sound, like a watch wrapped in cotton.
Mi le velosi nafasu, fe hataya ki polisiyen le no ore to.
I breathed quickly, even though the officers didn't hear it.
Mi le pala maxmo velosi ji maxmo joxupul, mas soti le foldarajeli sencu maxmo sotipul.
I spoke faster and more passionately, but the sound gradually became louder.
Mi le estaycu ji xijere tem nenmuhim xey, sotipul ji yon day jestu, mas soti le foldarajeli sencu maxmo sotipul.
I stood up and argued about unimportant things loudly and with big gestures, but the noise gradually became louder.
Ete xa no awidi keseba?
Why wouldn't they leave?
Mi le anda suo ji kanan yon day kadam, kwas mi le sencu gadibu kos etesu komenta, mas soti le foldarajeli sencu maxmo sotipul.
I walked back and forth with heavy steps, as if I got angry with their comments, but the sound gradually became louder.
O Teo!
Oh God!
Mi ger abil na fale keto?
What could I do?
Mi le paniko, mi le gadibu pala, mi le burlexi!
I panicked, I talked angrily, I swore!
Mi le hantacudu kursi hu mi le side per da ji le garu tahta yon to, mas umumi, soti le durepul sencu maxmo sotipul.
I grabbed the chair that I sat on and scraped it against the boards, but the sound continuously became louder overall.
To le sencu maxmo sotipul, maxmo sotipul, maxmo sotipul!
It became louder, louder, louder!
Ji ete le haji pala yukwe ji le tabasum.
And they still talked pleasantly and smiled.
Kam to le sen ible ki ete no ore to?
Was it possible that they didn't hear it?
Moyabil Teo!
Almighty God!
No, no!
No, no!
Ete le ore to!
They heard it!
Ete le gixim banto!
They suspected something!
Ete le jixi!
They knew!
Ete le coxo misu teror!
They mocked my terror!
Mi le fikir dento, ji mi haji fikir dento.
That's what I thought, and that's what I still think.
Mas he banto le sen maxmo bon kom hin suferi!
But anything was better than this suffering!
He banto le sen maxmo tahamulible kom hin coxo!
Anything was more tolerable than this mockery!
Mi le no haji abil na tahamul den sewdo tabasum!
I couldn't tolerate those fake smiles anymore!
Mi le ganjon ki mi musi na ayay or morcu!
I felt that I had to scream or die!
Ji fe nunya, ripul, am juiore!
And now, once again, listen!
Maxmo sotipul!
Louder!
Maxmo sotipul!
Louder!
Maxmo sotipul!
Louder!
Maxmo sotipul!
Louder!
"Uyu, buryen!" mi le dayloga, "Am esto na kwasigi! Mi etiraf krimen! Am ofplasi tahta! Hinloka, hinloka! To sen nabiza de tesu daybur tutum!"
"Villains!" I screamed, "Stop pretending! I admit the crime! Remove the boards! Here, here! It's the beating of his terrible heart!"
